fusions.name: Rein Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps a rein-hard lash from your wrist, dealing 4 damage, raising a welt that leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 2 seconds, and slowing it by 15% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Saddle Reach
fusions.desc: Leans down and grabs one enemy up to 6 tiles away for 24 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Given Its Head
fusions.desc: You slacken your grip and let your pace run: your movement speed rises 35% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Long-Ridden Endurance
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you restore 4 stamina a second for 5 seconds. Once every 30 seconds.
